name: Archery lessons
summary: How expats start archery in Singapore — range inductions, recurve basics, youth programmes, and gear rental before buying a bow.
body:
Archery ranges and clubs offer indoor/outdoor lanes with mandatory safety briefs. Beginners usually rent recurve kits; compounds come later. Youth programmes emphasise range etiquette as much as grouping arrows.

## Formats
- Walk-in taster lanes with coach
- Term courses for adults
- Kids’ holiday clinics
- Club membership pathways toward competition
- Corporate team sessions (noise and waivers apply)

Bare feet and loose clothing near lines get called out — follow dress codes.

## How to choose
Prefer coaches who teach anchor consistency and safety before score obsession. Ask about draw-weight progression for teens. Confirm whether arrows/targets are included. Peak weekends book out — weeknights may be calmer.

## Practical tip
Bring water and sunscreen for outdoor ranges. Do not buy a heavy bow after one fun session — rent through the first course.
